resources.string: Shows a small Handy button next to the text field you are typing in. Tap it to dictate: your voice is transcribed and the text is inserted at the cursor. Handy reads which field is focused (never password fields or excluded apps) and does not collect or send what you type.
Handy: tap to dictate, long-press for options
Handy is listening. Tap to stop.
Handy needs microphone access. Allow it in Handy\'s settings.
The microphone is unavailable (in use or blocked by the system).
Couldn\'t write into the field: the text is on the clipboard.
Enable “Handy dictation button” in Accessibility settings (Installed apps / Downloaded apps).

Android 13+ blocks accessibility for apps installed outside the Play Store. If the switch is greyed out: open App info › ⋮ menu (top right) › “Allow restricted settings”, confirm, then come back and enable the service. On Android 15+ the option only appears after you have tried to enable the service once.
Optional: a notification is shown while Handy is recording. Allow notifications to see it.
Tap the preview to see each state. The button fades further after 3 s without interaction.
Recording stops by itself after this much silence following speech. You can also tap the button to stop.
The button never appears in these apps. Banks and password managers found on this phone were added automatically. Handy itself, the system UI, the lock screen and launchers are always excluded.
Tap a field: the Handy button appears next to it, outside the keyboard. Tap the button, speak, and the transcript is inserted at the cursor. Download the speech model in settings first.
The placeholder must not be merged with the text
No button should appear on the password field.
Download the speech model in Handy\'s settings first.
Claude post-processing failed: raw transcript inserted.

Parakeet V3 (same model as Handy desktop), runs fully on the phone. 25 European languages including French and English, detected automatically. One-time download of about 490 MB (about 680 MB on disk); Wi-Fi recommended. Keep this screen open during the download.
Sends the transcript (text only, never audio) to Anthropic with your prompt. If the call fails, the raw transcript is inserted.
Stored encrypted on this phone (Android Keystore).
${output} is replaced by the transcript, as on desktop.
